name: renewal
title: Subscription Terms
paragraphs: Your subscription renews automatically each month at the current price. Renewal reminders are not sent. To avoid charges you must cancel at least thirty days before renewal.

name: sharing
title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We share your identifiable browsing history and contact details with advertising partners without requesting consent. Partners may use this data for their own marketing.

name: denial

paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We do not share identifiable data with advertising partners. Optional analytics requires explicit consent and can be withdrawn at any time.

name: cancellation

name: safe
title: Subscription Terms
paragraphs: Your subscription never renews automatically. You choose whether to purchase another month. You may cancel online at any time without a cancellation fee. Refunds required by consumer law are provided.
We do not sell personal data. Optional anonymized analytics requires explicit consent and can be disabled at any time. Usage events are deleted after thirty days.
